subject.title: feat(browser): support GPT-5.6 Sol and update Oracle skill

question: After preserving custom API model IDs, should Oracle expose both the movable gpt-5.6 family alias and the pinned gpt-5.6-sol alias?
rationale: The unified-picker repair is well supported, but the generic alias creates a durable public model-name contract whose target may change as ChatGPT adds GPT-5.6 variants.

options.title: Expose both aliases
options.body: Keep gpt-5.6 as the current family default and gpt-5.6-sol as the stable pinned target, then land one integrated branch.

options.title: Expose Sol only
options.body: Add only gpt-5.6-sol until another GPT-5.6 picker target makes a movable family alias necessary.

options.title: Land picker repair only
options.body: Merge unified Intelligence-picker compatibility and defer all new GPT-5.6 CLI aliases.

recommendation.title: Expose both aliases
recommendation.body: Keep gpt-5.6 as the current family default and gpt-5.6-sol as the stable pinned target, then land one integrated branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The current public model-routing contract and dominant history of the affected browser paths trace to this owner.
